notes: Solana staking rewards are earned by the wallet that holds the sCNDL. sCNDL in any of the account's eligible wallets counts toward Pro and earns the account's Hood staking reward; a wallet another account also claims, past the 200-wallet cap, or on an account with no EVM wallet earns none.
CNDL inside a pending withdrawal is in neither the CNDL nor the sCNDL balance, so it counts toward nothing for Pro during the wait.
Instant unstake is not offered to agents. A withdrawal waits for the pool's withdrawalTimelockSeconds before it can be finished.
